english.title: Fail to disclose a material particular to officer under Part A1 of Schedule 4A to the Immigration Act 1971
english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), having been required to provide information by **(..NAME OF OFFICER..), a relevant officer in the performance of functions under Part A1 of Schedule 4A to the Immigration Act 1971, intentionally failed to disclose a material particular
english.legislation: Contrary to paragraph K1(2)(b) and (4) of Schedule 4A to the Immigration Act 1971.

other.penalty:
Summary: maximum 51 weeks imprisonment and / or a fine.

Time limits for prosecutions:
6 months

Note
In relation to an offence committed before the coming into force of section 281(5) of the Criminal Justice Act 2003 the reference to 51 weeks is to be read as a reference to 6 months.
